verdict.rationale: Firebase's official CLI (firebase-tools) deploys code and assets to projects, offers `login:ci` for non-interactive token auth, and can import/export Auth users. The official MCP server lets an agent create and manage projects and Auth users, and Security Rules provide the policy layer. However, the evidence never shows the CLI deploying rules or configuring auth providers headlessly, and schema definition appears only via Gemini in the console. Missing for 10: documented CLI deployment of Security Rules/policies, headless auth-provider configuration (beyond user import/export), a scripted schema/index provisioning path, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end scripted backend setup.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent stand up a new backend — schema, auth, and policies — headlessly from the CLI in a script

citations.quote: login:ci | Generate an authentication token for use in non-interactive environments.
